banner: FINAL THESIS EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE. Tier-2 live software-based testbed: real 5G NAS/NGAP/GTP-U via Open5GS and UERANSIM, and a real IEEE 802.11 association and EAP-TLS exchange via mac80211_hwsim, over simulated radios. Not an RF, propagation, interference, channel-quality, spectrum-coexistence or physical-handover measurement. Generated from results/final/raw/; no value was typed by hand.
